name: WA Masuk
description: Pengganti message handler server/index.js: pesan WAHA -> dedup -> konteks -> Gemini (fallback model) -> tentukan langkah -> balas/ringkasan/simpan booking + QRIS DP.

parameters.query:
insert into bot.processed_messages (message_id) values ($1)
on conflict do nothing
returning message_id

select bot.check_slot(bot.resolve_date($1), $2, $3) as slot,
  bot.find_same_day_booking($4, bot.resolve_date($1)) as jam_lain
update public.whatsapp_requests set payment_status = 'failed' where id = $1::uuid
